cohort: 422 women with ≥2 prior CS who delivered across five hospitals in Democratic Republic of Congo
finding: Counseling about delivery method during prenatal care was associated with a higher likelihood of planned Cesarean section delivery among women with multiple prior Cesarean sections, but a significant number still labored at home and delivered emergently.
mod_finding: Among women who received counseling, 38.6% had a planned CS compared with 24.7% in the non-counseled group.
